meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: 安装并初始化 OneCLI Agent Vault，把 .env 里的密钥迁移进去，由 OneCLI 统一管理，之后代理通过网关获取密钥，不再直接接触原始密钥。
howto.when: 在 /update-nanoclaw 引入 OneCLI 破坏性变更之后，或首次设置 OneCLI 时触发。

say.text: 帮我初始化 OneCLI Agent Vault
say.note: 会检查 OneCLI 是否已安装并配置。

say.text: 把 .env 里的 Anthropic 密钥迁移到 OneCLI
say.note: 会扫描 .env 并迁移，然后删除原行。

say.text: 重新配置 OneCLI 凭据
say.note: 会重装 OneCLI 并重新注册密钥。

howto.what_en: Installs and initializes OneCLI Agent Vault, migrates .env credentials into it, and centralizes secret management so agents get keys via the gateway instead of raw values.
howto.when_en: Triggers after /update-nanoclaw introduces OneCLI as a breaking change, or during first-time OneCLI setup.

say_en.text: Initialize OneCLI Agent Vault for me.
say_en.note: Checks if OneCLI is installed and configured.

say_en.text: Migrate the Anthropic keys from .env to OneCLI.
say_en.note: Scans .env, migrates, and removes the original lines.
